segments.t: 周二傍晚的前台，汉娜在阿瑟和伊芙琳面前铺开了米色卡纸和一支黑笔。先完整听一遍吧。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段满怀希望的对话。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
'看看我们给临街大门做的小木牌：简短、温馨，而且通俗易懂。'
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
'大声念给我听听，汉娜，让我听听街坊邻居听起来是什么感觉。'
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
'“九号房间花园咖啡馆：新鲜热汤、刚出炉的面包、柠檬挞和茶。每天营业。”'
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
'在下面还有一行小字：“周五六点钟钢琴茶歇。”'
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
'我姑妈当年雷打不动的周五时光，就挂在大门上！这让我感到很自豪。'
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
'我还用大号数字把四个价格写得很清楚，这样谁都不用眯着眼睛看了。'
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
'就算不戴眼镜，我在两米开外都能看清那些数字！'
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
'你在门边放了一个小篮子作为社区图书共享角吗？'
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
'就在钢琴旁边：全是从走廊书柜里拿出来的那些干净的游记！'
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
'一个对公众开放的咖啡馆、一个社区阅读角，还有现场音乐：市政规定的每一条都做到了！'
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
'让我去把那首圆舞曲从头到尾练一遍，趁泰莎在烤蛋挞皮的时候。'
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
'我要把这些菜单卡片拿到厨房去，顺便看看泰莎那边怎么样了！'
现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Look at our small wooden sign for the street gate: short, warm, and easy to read.
Read it aloud for me, Hannah, so I hear how a neighbor hears it.
'Room Nine Garden Cafe: Fresh Soup, Warm Bread, Lemon Tart and Tea. Open Daily.'
And underneath in smaller letters: 'Friday Piano Tea at Six O'Clock.'
My aunt's exact Friday hour right on the gate! That makes me proud.
I also wrote the four prices clearly in big numbers so nobody has to squint.
Even without glasses I can read those numbers from two meters away!
Did you leave a small basket by the door for neighborhood book sharing?
Right beside the piano: all those clean travel books from the hallway bookcase!
A public cafe, a neighborhood reading corner, and live music: every word of the city rule!
Let me go practice the waltz once through while Tessa bakes the tart shells.
I will carry these menu cards into the kitchen and check on Tessa!
清晰的菜单、共享的书籍、周五的钢琴时光，每一项关于传承的承诺都在逐渐成真。我们下个场景厨房见。
See you soon!
